query: Please implement an instant messaging website for real-time communication between users. The website should have functionalities for sending and receiving messages, creating group chats, adding friends, and viewing chat history. Users should be able to log in and send text, images, videos, and other types of messages, create group chats and invite friends to join, add friends and manage their friend list, and view historical chat records. Set primary background to morning mist and elements to navy.
